_1_pin: Copy this file to upstream.manifest.json and replace revision with the commit you intend to pin. 'git ls-remote https://github.com/q-rz/enamel HEAD' prints one. A branch or tag is refused: it can move, so it is not a snapshot.
_2_license: license stays 'unknown' until the upstream terms are confirmed. Unknown means the snapshot must not be committed to this repository; fetching it locally is fine.
_3_include: include holds fnmatch patterns against archive-relative paths, and '*' also matches '/', so the default takes the whole tree. Narrow it once 'fetch_upstream.py --inventory' has shown the real layout.
